items.title: Zelensky says senior officials named in drug ring tapes have no links to criminal network
items.teaser: According to President Volodymyr Zelensky, the Khimprom drug ring has already made inroads into Poland and is trying to enter Germany. Ukraine has intelligence on this, Zelensky said.

items.title: Prozess in Saarbrücken - Syrer soll Blutbad an seiner Schule geplant haben
items.teaser: 22-Jähriger steht in Saarbrücken wegen Anschlagsvorbereitung vor Gericht.

items.title: Strike on Pavlohrad: One killed, injury toll rises to ten
items.teaser: Ten people were injured and one person was killed in a Russian missile strike on Pavlohrad on November 14.

items.title: Bulgarien stoppt Waffenlieferungen an die Ukraine
items.teaser: Bulgarien wird den Kauf von Waffen für die Ukraine nicht mehr finanzieren sowie keine Waffen und Munition aus den Beständen seiner Armee liefern.

items.title: Kremlin confirms date of Trump, Xi and Putin meeting
items.teaser: The Kremlin has stated that a trilateral meeting between the leaders of the United States, China and Russia is scheduled to take place in Shenzhen on 19 November.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia rises to 22
items.teaser: The number of people injured in the Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia during the afternoon of November 14 has risen to 22.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Pawlohrad: ein Mensch getötet, zehn weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Raketenangriff auf die Stadt Pawlohrad in der Region Dnipropetrowsk sind 10 Menschen verletzt worden. Ein Mensch kam ums Leben, teilt die regionale Militärverwaltung der Region Dnipropetrowsk auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russen greifen Pawlohrad mit Raketen an: es gibt drei Verletzte, darunter ein Kind
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Raketenangriff auf die Stadt Pawlohrad in der Region Dnipropetrowsk sind drei Menschen verletzt worden, darunter ein Kind, teilt der Leiter des Gebietsrates, Mykola Lukaschuk, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Putin's Kostiantynivka proposal aims to seize city, push toward Kramatorsk, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed establishing a temporary “humanitarian mission” in the embattled eastern Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, which President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 13 could provide Russian forces with an opportunity to enter and occupy the city.

items.title: Khmara discusses strengthening air defence, long-range capabilities with Canadian counterpart
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Canada's Defence Minister David McGuinty discussed continued support for Ukraine, including strengthening air defence, expanding long-range strike capabilities and supplying ammunition for F-16 aircraft cannons.

items.title: Putin has new plan for Ukraine’s fortress city — and he may be counting on Trump to make it happen, expert says
items.teaser: Russia is using diplomatic channels to force Ukraine to withdraw from Kostiantynivka, Defense Express director Serhii Zhurets told Espreso.

items.title: One killed and 10 injured, including child, in Russian strike on Pavlohrad
items.teaser: A Russian attack on the city of Pavlohrad has killed one person and injured ten others, including a 7-year-old boy.

items.title: Russians launch missile strike on Pavlohrad, leaving three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a missile strike on Pavlohrad during the afternoon of November 14. The attack damaged residential infrastructure and injured three people.

items.title: Russia now sends mobilized men to front in 5 to 7 days because its losses outrun its recruits, Ukrainian commander says
items.teaser: Fewer clashes on some fronts show Russia is running out of men, a Ukrainian drone-brigade commander claims.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine needs 2.5 times as many F-16s in the air at once
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine must significantly increase the number of F-16s operating simultaneously in the air due to constant maintenance needs.

items.title: Großbrand in Erdgasanlage in Region Poltawa nach russischem Angriff
items.teaser: Russische Drohnen haben am 14. November eine der Erdgasanlagen in der Region Poltawa, die von der staatlichen Naftogaz-Gruppe betrieben werden, angegriffen. Es brach ein Feuer aus.

items.title: Russia will not shape security architecture of free Europe, Canadian PM Carney says, as Moscow floats separate non-aggression pacts with NATO countries and return to 1997 lines
items.teaser: Ottawa will never walk away from any ally, he states.

items.title: Russian drones attack Naftogaz facility in Poltava region
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked one of the Naftogaz Group's facilities in the Poltava region during the day on November 14, causing a fire.

items.title: Russian drone strike kills man on scooter in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: A 45-year-old civilian riding along the central road of Kushuhum has been killed in a Russian drone attack.

items.title: Russia is betting another year of European elections to outlast support for Ukraine, Kyiv analyst says
items.teaser: Russia has no reason to hurry toward a peace deal, says Iuliia Osmolovska of the GLOBSEC think tank, because time, another winter, and a year of European elections are working in its favor.

items.title: Ukraine's Security Service strikes key Russian oil export preparation hub
items.teaser: Long-range UAVs operated by the Security Service of Ukraine have struck a crucial node for mixing and preparing Urals crude oil for export.

items.title: Russland greift Energieanlage in Region Odessa an: 50 Tausend Kunden ohne Strom
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Angriffs auf eine Energieanlage in der Region Odessa sind fast 50.000 Verbraucher ohne Strom, teilt die DTEK-Gruppe auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Trump may delay strikes on Iran if Yemen refrains from new provocations – Reuters
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump recently told his senior advisers that he may hold off on strikes against Iran if Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen refrain from further provocations.

items.title: Neue Impulse für NATO-Mitgliedschaft der Ukraine
items.teaser: Die USA haben nach Angaben des ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj einen NATO-Beitritt der Ukraine ins Spiel gebracht. Voraussetzung sei, dass die Ukraine die Donbass-Region im Osten aufgebe.

items.title: Ukraine hits key Russian oil hub, military airbase in latest long-range strikes
items.teaser: The General Staff reported a fire at the Samara linear production control station near the village of Prosvet in Samara Oblast, some 950 kilometers east of Ukraine-controlled territory, with several oil storage tanks on fire.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Revising Europe's security architecture would be dangerous
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said Russia wants to change the security framework in Europe, at the very least, and warned that this is dangerous.

items.title: Bulgaria halts arms and ammunition supplies to Ukraine from its military stockpiles
items.teaser: Bulgaria will not provide Ukraine with any new financial assistance for weapons purchases and is ending the supply of arms and ammunition from its military stockpiles.

items.title: Ukrainische Dröhnen treffen Energieanlage in der russischen Region Samara
items.teaser: Langstreckendrohnen des Spezialeinsatzzentrums "Alpha" des ukrainischen Geheimdienstes SBU eine Linien-Produktions- und Dispatching-Station in der Nähe der Ortschaft Proswet in der russischen Region Samara angegriffen.

items.title: WTA Finals: Svitolina defeats Sabalenka to reach semifinals
items.teaser: Ukraine’s top-ranked tennis player, Elina Svitolina, has continued her bid for the title at the WTA Finals in the American city of Indian Wells, where the tournament offers a prize pool of $10 million.

items.title: Seventeen injured, including children, in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Seventeen people, including two children, have been injured in a Russian strike on the Voznesenivskyi district in Zaporizhzhia on 14 November.

items.title: Selenskyj: Wir brauchen zweieinhalb Mal mehr einsatzbereite F-16 am Himmel
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, dass die Ukraine zweieinhalb Mal mehr F-16 in der Luft brauche, als derzeit zur Verfügung stünden.

items.title: Vacancy: journalist
items.teaser: Want to tell Ukraine's story to the world? We're looking for a journalist who gets it. Euromaidan Press…

items.title: USA bieten Ukraine laut Selenskyj NATO-Beitritt bei Gebietsverzicht
items.teaser: Ein Rückzug aus dem Donbass im Tausch für einen NATO-Beitritt - das haben die USA der Ukraine nach Angaben Selenskyjs nahegelegt. Unter bestimmten Bedingungen würde er diese Frage in einem Referendum zur Abstimmung stellen, so der Präsident.

items.title: US Senator calls Russia's demand for NATO troop withdrawal 'preposterous'
items.teaser: US Senate Intelligence Committee Chairman and Republican Senator Tom Cotton has described Russia's demand that NATO withdraw its forces to the alliance's "1997 borders" as absurd, saying that further negotiations with Moscow are currently pointless.

items.title: Police officer shields injured boy, 9, during repeat Russian attack in Sumy Oblast
items.teaser: Police officers in Sumy Oblast have rescued a 54-year-old woman and her nine-year-old grandson after a Russian attack caused a fire at their home. When Russian forces attempted a second drone strike, one of the officers shielded the boy with his body.

items.title: Zelensky says Starshield restrictions give Russia more room to attack, accuses SpaceX of treating occupied territories as 'not ours'
items.teaser: "If you impose restrictions there, you are already partially recognizing the temporarily occupied territories as not ours," Zelensky told journalists, referring to the existing ban on Ukraine using Starshield to target sites inside Russia, which has now been partially extended to Ukrainian territories occupied by Mosco

items.title: Estonia bans Russian and Belarusian athletes from entering country
items.teaser: Estonia's Culture Ministry has told the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS) that Russian and Belarusian athletes are barred from entering the country because of Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia: Residential building, educational institution damaged, 15 injured
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the Voznesenivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia, injuring four people initially.

items.title: Poland will not fund purchase of US weapons for Ukraine: "We spend a lot on defence"
items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has said Poland will not, for now, fund purchases of US-made weapons for Ukraine under the Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List (PURL) programme because of its high defence spending. The US-NATO programme enables NATO allies to purchase American weapons for Ukraine.

items.title: Debris from Russian drone falls on medical facility grounds in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle fell on the grounds of a medical facility in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district.

items.title: Ukraine and UK discuss new military aid package ahead of Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara has spoken to UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting ahead of the next meeting of the Ukraine Defence Contact Group (also known as the Ramstein format).

items.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says security deal could go to referendum
items.teaser: The US has broached the idea of Kyiv giving up the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, the Ukrainian president said.

items.title: Zelensky: Putin personally does not support ceasefire
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russian President Vladimir Putin personally does not support establishing a ceasefire.

items.title: Zelensky on Starshield restrictions in temporarily occupied territories: Ukraine to raise this issue at every level
items.teaser: Starshield speed restrictions of up to 161 km/h remain in place in Ukraine's temporarily occupied territories. This complicates the interception of Russian jet-powered Shahed drones and gives Russia additional opportunities to launch attacks. Ukraine will raise the issue through all relevant channels.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports strike on oil facility in Russia's Samara Oblast and military airfield in Lipetsk
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck an oil facility in Russia's Samara Oblast, where the Urals export crude blend is produced, and the Lipetsk-2 military airfield in Lipetsk Oblast on 13 November.

items.title: US floats NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for Donbas withdrawal, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "The Americans raised the question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?' This was the first time this issue had been raised," President Volodymyr Zelensky told journalists.

items.title: SSU drones strike oil facility in Russia’s Samara region
items.teaser: Long-range drones operated by the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) struck the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station near the settlement of Prosvet in Russia’s Samara region.

items.title: Russian forces strike Derhachi with drone, leaving three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the city of Derhachi in the Kharkiv region with a drone, injuring three people. Four children suffered acute stress reactions.

items.title: Selenskyj berichtet von US-Vorstoß in Friedensgesprächen
items.teaser: Gedankenspiel oder konkrete Überlegung? US-Unterhändler sprachen nach Angaben von Präsident Selenskyj über einen Rückzug aus der Region Donbass im Tausch für einen Nato-Beitritt.

items.title: Selenskyj: USA bieten Ukraine erstmals Nato-Mitgliedschaft gegen Donbass-Rückzug an
items.teaser: Wenn die Partner vorschlagen, den Donbass im Austausch für echte Sicherheitsgarantien zu verlassen, die unter anderem die Mitgliedschaft der Ukraine in der NATO und der EU vorsehen, werde er sich mit dieser Frage an die Gesellschaft wenden.

items.title: At least 7 killed, 80 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine; Zaporizhzhia among worst hit
items.teaser: In Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Russian attacks killed three people, including a child, and injured 62 others, including eight children, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

items.title: Russia seeks to capture Kostiantynivka under pretext of evacuating civilians – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia is proposing a "humanitarian operation" in Kostiantynivka under the pretext of protecting civilians, but its aim is to occupy the city and advance toward Kramatorsk and Sloviansk.

items.title: Russia strikes energy infrastructure in Odesa Oblast again, cutting power to 50,000 households
items.teaser: Energy crews are clearing rubble and repairing damaged equipment in Odesa Oblast after Russian forces struck a DTEK power facility on the morning of 14 November.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia seeks to revise Europe’s security architecture
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russia is seeking to revise the security architecture, at least in Europe, and that this is dangerous.

items.title: Zelenskyy: US proposes NATO membership in exchange for Donbas withdrawal for the first time
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has revealed that US negotiators asked whether Ukraine would withdraw from Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, adding that any concrete security package would go to a public vote.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland nutzt Evakuierung als Vorwand zur Einnahme von Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Russland schlägt „humanitäre Mission“ in Kostjantyniwka unter dem Vorwand des Schutzes der Zivilbevölkerung vor.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facility in Odesa region, nearly 50,000 consumers left without power
items.teaser: Nearly 50,000 consumers in the Odesa region remain without electricity following a Russian strike on an energy facility.

items.title: Zelenskyy: SpaceX claims Starshield restrictions are technical issues
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has reported widespread Starshield disruptions across front-line sectors for a fifth consecutive day, questioning SpaceX’s explanation to Ukraine's Defence Ministry.

items.title: Warehouses damaged in Russian drone attack on Kyiv region
items.teaser: A fire broke out in warehouse facilities in the Vyshhorod district following a Russian attack on Saturday.

items.title: Russia directs money from seized Western companies towards war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Bloomberg reports that Western companies stripped of operational control in Russia – such as Metro, Rockwool and AB InBev Efes – are channelling billions of roubles to the People’s Front to buy army gear.

items.title: Russian forces attack Hlukhiv in morning drone strike, three injured, including child
items.teaser: Three people, including a nine-year-old boy, were injured in a drone attack on the city of Hlukhiv in the Sumy region early on November 14.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: Trümmer fallen im Stadtteil Holossijiwskyj an zwei Orten herab
items.teaser: Im Bezirk Holossijiwskyj-von Kyjiw sind an zwei Orten Trümmer einer russischen Drohne herabgefallen.

items.title: US Senate reacts to Russia's demand for NATO to withdraw troops
items.teaser: Senator Tom Cotton has said Vladimir Putin will only end the war when convinced he cannot win, calling further negotiations a farce following Russia's demand for NATO forces to return to 1997 borders.

items.title: Editor’s Picks: Latest Additions to the 2026 Yearbook
items.teaser: The latest updates to the 2026 Yearbook Commercial Arbitration are available on the Kluwer Arbitration database.

items.title: Drone attack: Debris falls at two locations in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian UAV fell at two locations in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district on Saturday.

items.title: WSJ: US senators tell Musk to preserve records on Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
items.teaser: US Democratic senators have told SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to preserve all records relating to restrictions the company imposed on Ukraine's use of its Starlink and Starshield satellite services.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 273 Gefechte an der Front, die heftigsten Kämpfe dauern im Raum Pokrowsk an
items.teaser: Am 13. November kam es zu 273 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Democrats urge Musk to preserve records on Starlink operations in Ukraine – media
items.teaser: Democrats on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee have asked SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to "preserve all documents, communications and electronically stored information" related to the company's Starlink and Starshield systems in Ukraine, amid reports that their use by the Ukrainian military has been restricted.

items.title: NATO und EU beraten über weitere Unterstützung für die Ukraine
items.teaser: NATO und EU beraten über weitere Unterstützung für die Ukraine

items.title: One killed, two injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv region over past day
items.teaser: One person was killed and two civilians injured as seven settlements in the Kharkiv region came under Russian attacks over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Hluchiw am Morgen: Drei Verletzte, darunter ein Kind
items.teaser: Infolge eines Drohnenangriffs wurden in Hluchiw in der Region Sumy drei Menschen verletzt, darunter ein 9-jähriger Junge.

items.title: Estonia outlines details of Ukrainian attack on Russian missile ship in Baltic Sea
items.teaser: Colonel Aron Kalmus, Deputy Commander of the Estonian Division, which brings together Estonian forces and allied units assigned to it, has described how several Ukrainian drones struck the Naro-Fominsk, a Russian Baltic Fleet corvette, during a large-scale attack on the port of Ust-Luga.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 81 von 96 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 81 von 96 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 13. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Two killed, five injured in Russian attacks on Kherson region over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces killed two people and injured five others in the Kherson region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russians attack Hlukhiv in morning: nine-year-old boy in intensive care, police officer injured
items.teaser: A nine-year-old boy is in intensive care after a Russian drone struck a house in Hlukhiv on 14 November. His grandmother and a police officer were also injured, while an earlier attack on Shostka left three people wounded.

items.title: Three killed, 62 injured in Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia region over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 884 attacks on the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours, killing three people, including a child, and injuring 62 others.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,620,630 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: Russian forces suffered 1,710 casualties over the past day.

items.title: Tausche Frieden gegen Donbass
items.teaser: Washington drängt Kiew zu Gebietsabtretungen. Putin fordert auch Land, das seine Truppen nicht kontrollieren. Europa hat sich auf ein Verhandlungsteam geeinigt.

items.title: Widespread emergency power outage reported in Sumy region
items.teaser: A large-scale emergency power outage has affected part of the Sumy region following systematic Russian attacks on energy infrastructure.

items.title: War update: 273 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
items.teaser: On November 13, Ukrainian forces engaged in 273 combat clashes with Russian invaders along the front line.

items.title: Wintervorbereitung: Selenskyj trifft Bürgermeister – regelmäßiger Dialog geplant
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat mit Bürgermeistern aller Regionen der Ukraine die Vorbereitung auf den Winter angesichts der anhaltenden russischen Angriffe erörtert.

items.title: Battlefield sees 273 combat clashes over past day, most on Pokrovsk front – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 273 combat clashes across the battlefield on 13 November, with the heaviest fighting on the Pokrovsk front. The Russians also carried out 64 airstrikes and deployed 4,844 kamikaze drones.

items.title: Three killed and seven injured in Russian attacks on three Ukrainian oblasts
items.teaser: Russian strikes across three Ukrainian oblasts over the past day killed three people and injured seven others. Residential buildings, infrastructure facilities and an ambulance were damaged.

items.title: Air defenses neutralize 81 of 96 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine since evening
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 81 of the 96 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine since the evening of November 13.

items.title: Russia demanded NATO return to its 1997 positions during Abu Dhabi talks – NYT
items.teaser: A document presented by Russian officials during negotiations with US envoys in Abu Dhabi calls for NATO to return to its 1997 military positions. The demand comes amid US efforts to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,710 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 14, 2026, have reached approximately 1,620,630 personnel, including 1,710 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 81 Russian drones overnight, with strikes recorded at eight locations
items.teaser: Russia launched 96 drones against Ukraine overnight. Ukrainian air defence destroyed 81 drones, with strikes recorded at eight locations and falling debris at two others.

items.title: Trump to meet with Xi and Putin next Thursday – New York Post
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.

items.title: Evacuees from Oleshky receive medical and social assistance in Zakarpattia region
items.teaser: Residents evacuated from the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region continue to arrive in the Zakarpattia region, where they are receiving medical, social and psychological assistance.

items.title: Europe must learn modern warfare from Ukraine – ARX Robotics CEO
items.teaser: European armies must learn from Ukraine's experience in modern warfare and accelerate the adoption of new military technologies to avoid falling behind Russia in critical areas.

items.title: US Democrats direct Musk to preserve records on Ukraine's Starlink restriction, WSJ reports
items.teaser: "The October and November restrictions now raise the disturbing possibility that these vulnerabilities persist even within systems on which the U.S. government relies," Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons wrote.

items.title: Zelensky holds meeting with mayors on winter preparations, says talks will be regular
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has discussed preparations by communities across Ukraine for the winter period amid continued Russian attacks with mayors from different parts of the country.

items.title: Russia loses 1,710 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,710 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Schiphol Airport donates 29 passenger buses to Ukraine
items.teaser: The Netherlands' largest airport, Schiphol, has donated 29 passenger buses to Ukraine. The buses were previously used to transport passengers from aircraft to the terminal.

items.title: Senegal Youth Olympics in Dakar end on high note
items.teaser: Enthusiastic crowds attended the games in Senegal, with China taking home the most gold medals. It's the first Olympic Games since Russia's war on Ukraine where Russian athletes can compete under their own flag.

items.title: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives to Russian attacks, nearly 400 of them this year – Kalashnyk
items.teaser: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives as a result of Russian attacks since the start of the full-scale invasion, with nearly 400 of those losses occurring this year.

items.title: Weißes Haus kündigt Dreiertreffen von Trump mit Putin und Xi an
items.teaser: Es wäre das erste Dreiertreffen der Staatschefs der USA, Russlands und Chinas. Laut Weißem Haus soll es beim kommenden Apec-Gipfel in Shenzhen stattfinden. Hauptthema: der Abbau von Atomwaffen. Auch der Iran-Krieg könnte zur Sprache kommen.

items.title: Flights resume across US: Trump doubts system failure was caused by cyberattack or AI
items.teaser: The FAA has lifted its nationwide ground stop after a major communications failure. Donald Trump has dismissed suggestions of a cyberattack or AI involvement, while flight delays continue across US airports.

items.title: Russia designates Ukraine's Yellow Ribbon resistance movement ‘extremist organization’
items.teaser: Russia has designated the Yellow Ribbon Ukrainian resistance movement an “extremist organization” and banned its activities on Russian territory.

items.title: Historic first summit for Trump, Xi, Putin will not focus on Ukraine, White House says
items.teaser: A U.S. official said that a trilateral meeting has been planned, but will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

items.title: Sirens sound at major US air base in UK amid suspected drone threat
items.teaser: US military personnel were ordered to shelter at RAF Lakenheath on 13 November following suspected unauthorised drone activity. No injuries or damage were reported.

items.title: SSU foils Russian plot to strike Kyiv, arrests suspected agent spying on military positions
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has detained a man in Kyiv suspected of helping guide Russian missile and drone attacks and prepare new strikes against Ukrainian Defense Forces units and civilian facilities in the capital.

items.title: National Guard drones hit over 316,000 enemy targets since Russia’s full-scale invasion – Pivnenko
items.teaser: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion, Ukrainian National Guard unmanned systems crews have hit more than 316,000 enemy targets, nearly 150,000 of which have been destroyed.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi will meet in China to discuss nuclear arms control – NYP
items.teaser: The US, Russian and Chinese leaders are set to meet at the APEC summit in Shenzhen to discuss a nuclear arms control agreement. The talks may also cover Iran and North Korea.

items.title: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity at military base in UK
items.teaser: The U.S. Air Force has maintained a presence at the base since 1948, as part of the longstanding military partnership between the United States and the United Kingdom.

items.title: Volunteer wanted: army fundraiser coordinator
items.teaser: Euromaidan Press readers have raised over $1 million for Ukraine's defenders. We are looking for a volunteer to…

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Aktualisierung der Anhänge der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung
items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Hinweis zum Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen sind ab 16. September 2026 möglich.

items.title: Erinnerung: Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO bis 11. September 2026
items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Förderkompass 2026
items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juli 2026
Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO
items.teaser: Wie in den vergangenen Monaten bereits angekündigt, hat die EU-Kommission den in Art. 26 Abs. 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-VO) vorgesehenen Prozess zur Evaluation gestartet.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces eliminate nearly 24,000 Russian troops in October

items.title: Instead of a single representative, a whole team: Europe decides who will represent it in talks with Russia to end the war
items.teaser: The representatives will include EU institutions and the E5 group of countries—Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Italy and Poland, according to Costa.

items.title: Energieminister wollen kritische Infrastruktur besser schützen
items.teaser: Der Bund solle Gesetze anpassen und einen Resilienzfonds finanzieren. Darauf einigte man sich bei der Konferenz in Göttingen.

items.teaser: Ukraine is hoping for a large-scale prisoner-of-war exchange that could see more than 1,000 people released on each side.

items.title: European leaders agree on joint team for Ukraine peace negotiations, Costa says

items.title: German Gereon ground robots equipped with Ukrainian Saber combat modules enter production and delivery
items.teaser: German defense company ARX Robotics has begun producing and delivering Gereon unmanned ground vehicles equipped with Ukrainian-made Saber combat modules.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defenders down Russian Geran-5 jet drone for first time using Swedish RBS-70 MANPADS
items.teaser: Fighters of Ukraine’s 1027th Anti-Aircraft Missile and Artillery Regiment have shot down a Russian Geran-5 jet-powered drone in the Kyiv region using the Swedish-made RBS-70 man-portable air defense system (MANPADS).

items.title: Geheimdienst-Reform: Forscher sieht keine "Stasi 2.0" kommen
items.teaser: Die im Bundestag beschlossene Reform öffnet dem BND neue Möglichkeiten und dem Verfassungsschutz auch Wohnungen. Experte Luca Manns sieht aber keine "Stasi 2.0" kommen.

items.teaser: Russian forces have damaged 10 DTEK energy facilities in the Kyiv region over the past week.

items.title: France seizes Ukrainian oligarch Zhevago's $40 million Paris mansion in embezzlement investigation

items.title: Plane aborts landing at Warsaw airport due to drone
items.teaser: A flight from Prague to Warsaw was forced to abandon its landing approach after a drone appeared in its path. The aircraft later landed safely, and airport operations continued as normal.

items.teaser: German defense company ARX Robotics and Ukrainian company Roboneers have delivered the first batch of jointly manufactured Rys Pro unmanned ground vehicles to Ukraine, even before the official establishment of their joint venture, ARX Industries.

items.teaser: On the social media accounts of a group of young foreign visitors touring the Russian-occupied part of Donetsk Oblast, the war-ravaged region is presented as an appealing travel destination. items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 13. November haben die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine eine Lukoil - Ölraffinerie in der russischen Stadt Wolgograd getroffen, wie der Generalstab via Telegram mitteilt.

items.title: International Ice Hockey Federation investigates Russia’s incorporation of teams from occupied Ukrainian territories into its tournament system
items.teaser: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) has launched an investigation into evidence that teams from Ukraine's temporarily occupied territories are competing in tournaments held under the auspices of the Russian Ice Hockey Federation.

items.title: EU leaders agree on joint team to represent Europe in Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: EU leaders have agreed on who will represent Europe in negotiations aimed at ending Russia’s war against Ukraine, following an informal meeting of the European Council in Dublin today.

items.title: "This is our time": Polish PM Tusk reacts to announcement of Europe's role in Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: Polish PM Donald Tusk has welcomed the E5 countries and EU institutions joining Ukraine peace talks, stressing that peace in Ukraine and Europe's security are at stake.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia launch 'new format' for evacuating civilians from occupied territories, ombudsman says
items.teaser: According to the ombudsman, 16 Ukrainians were returned on Nov. 12 under the new arrangement.

items.title: Ukrainisches Außenministerium begrüßt den Ausschluss von TASS aus Europäischer Allianz der Nachrichtenagenturen
items.teaser: Das Außenministerium der Ukraine hat die Entscheidung der Europäischen Allianz der Nachrichtenagenturen (European Alliance of News Agencies - EANA) zum Ausschluss der russischen staatlichen Nachrichtenagentur TASS begrüßt.

items.title: Merz outlines two key priorities for Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin
items.teaser: More than 20 heads of state and government are expected to discuss funding for Ukraine’s defense in 2027 and coordinate a common position ahead of future peace talks with Russia at the Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin on November 19.

items.title: EU einigt sich auf europäisches Team für Ukraine-Verhandlungen
items.teaser: Lange wurde diskutiert, wer Europa bei Gesprächen mit Russland über ein Ende des Kriegs gegen die Ukraine vertreten soll. Nun gibt es eine Einigung: Das Team bilden Vertreter der EU-Institutionen und aus fünf Ländern - darunter auch Deutschland.

items.title: Russische Nachrichtenagentur TASS aus Europäischer Allianz der Nachrichtenagenturen ausgeschlossen
items.teaser: Die russische Nachrichtenagentur TASS ist aus der Europäischen Allianz der Nachrichtenagenturen (European Alliance of News Agencies - EANA) ausgeschlossen worden.

items.title: European Council president explains why EU has chosen team rather than single representative for Ukraine peace talks

items.title: Ukraine at OSCE: Russia living in ‘parallel reality’ about its battlefield gains
items.teaser: Russia’s leadership continues to spread false claims about its battlefield gains, while Ukraine’s Defense Forces have stabilized the situation and carried out a number of successful counteroffensive operations.

items.title: Russia’s Starlink rival falls short: None of 30 Rassvet satellites has reached planned orbit, HUR reports
items.teaser: Ukraine's military intelligence says Russia's satellite network faces problems with orbital positioning, foreign component supplies, and user terminals despite Moscow's plans for rapid expansion.

items.teaser: Die Affäre um Nvidia-Chef Jensen Huang erschüttert das Silicon Valley: Es geht um mögliche Spionage, Chip-Schmuggel nach China und die Frage, was die US-Regierung wusste. Tech-Analyst Philipp Klöckner erklärt, welche Folgen das hat.

items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian strike on the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia has risen to 50, including eight children.

items.title: World Boxing Council maintains sanctions against Russia and Belarus
items.teaser: The World Boxing Council (WBC) has officially decided to maintain sanctions against representatives of Russia and Belarus.

items.title: European representatives for Ukraine peace talks revealed
items.teaser: EU leaders have agreed that Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland and EU institutions will represent Europe in negotiations to end Russia's war in Ukraine.

items.teaser: Der Bundestag hat den Gesetzentwurf zur Reform der Geheimdienste gebilligt. Mit der Novelle werden die Befugnisse des Bundesnachrichtendienstes und des Bundesamts für Verfassungsschutz zur Abwehr von Sabotage, Spionage und Cyberangriffen deutlich erweitert.

items.title: Neutral Moldova approves military cooperation deal with Ukraine as Russian drones violate its airspace
items.teaser: Moldova ratifies an agreement covering defense technology, cybersecurity, and airspace protection as Russian attacks on neighboring Ukraine increasingly spill across its borders.

items.title: Europe will be represented for first time at upcoming peace talks – Merz

items.title: Politico: EU leaders close to agreeing on negotiating team for Ukraine talks
items.teaser: EU leaders are close to agreeing on a negotiating team involving Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland and EU institutions for talks on Ukraine, Politico reports.

items.teaser: Die Russen könnten eine mögliche humanitäre Operation in Kostjantyniwka in der Region Donezk nutzen, um Soldaten auszuwechseln und Kriegsgerät dorthin zu verlegen, wie sie das zuvor in Oleschky getan haben, sagte der Sprecher des ukrainischen Präsidenten, Dmytro Lytwyn, vor der Presse.

items.title: Finland and Norway will stop Russian athletes at the border, even those federations cleared to compete
items.teaser: Both measures arrive just as the winter sports season opens on Finnish and Norwegian snow.

items.title: "Literally fighting for their lives": Human Rights Commissioner's Office shares stories of residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky
items.teaser: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky describe surviving on courgettes, being hunted by Russian drones and enduring years without appropriate medical care.

items.title: Russian troops fail to advance toward Orikhiv – South Group of Forces

items.title: EU einigt sich auf Verhandlungsteam für Ukraine-Gespräche

items.title: Serbia's incoming ruling party declares support for Ukraine's sovereignty

items.title: Merz beansprucht Teilnahme an künftigen Ukraine-Gesprächen

items.title: Lubinets says potential humanitarian mission in Kostiantynivka not discussed

items.title: Starshield -Einschränkungen über russisch besetztem Gebiet der Ukraine festgestellt
items.teaser: Störungen bei der Funktionsweise von Starshield werden derzeit über dem gesamten vorübergehend von Russland besetzten Gebiet der Ukraine festgestellt. Auf dem von der Ukraine kontrollierten Gebiet werden keine Einschränkungen gemeldet.

items.title: Ukraine seeks international support for agricultural export logistics – Vysotskyi

items.title: Sybiha to visit UAE for international security forum
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha will visit the United Arab Emirates on November 13-14 to attend the 16th annual Sir Bani Yas Forum, which focuses on key security challenges in the Middle East and around the world.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Saporischschja: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf 30, Rettungsarbeiten abgeschlossen

items.title: Lithuanian police detain men who allegedly tore down Ukrainian flag from ministry building
items.teaser: Law enforcement in Vilnius arrested a 21-year-old man charged with desecrating a foreign state symbol after he allegedly pulled down and threw away a Ukrainian flag from the Ministry of Transport and Communications.

items.title: Koretskyi says fuel prices will fall as new supplies arrive
items.teaser: Petrol prices in Ukraine are expected to decline once new fuel supplies purchased at lower prices reach the country.

items.title: Göttingen: Energieminister beraten über Sicherheit
items.teaser: Sie fordern vom Bund Stromnetze besser zu schützen, auch vor Drohnen über Energiespeichern oder Umspannwerken. Reporter Dennis Pyzik berichtet.

items.title: Russia’s leaked death register turns up fewer war dead from Nepal, India, and Sri Lanka than their governments report

items.title: About 35 drones assembled for Ukrainian military at defense forum in The Hague
items.teaser: A drone-building workshop was held during the European Defense Innovation Forum (EDIF 2026) in The Hague, where participants assembled about 35 drones for the Ukrainian military over two days.

items.title: UK blacklists Slavneft and says it now sanctions all ten of Russia’s top oil producers
items.teaser: The package also targets Rosneft's flagship Arctic venture Vostok Oil, major coal companies, and 11 ships linked to Russian oil and gas.

items.title: Russian drone strike causes major sunflower oil spill at facility in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike on a facility belonging to Kernel agricultural holding in the Mykolaiv region caused a sunflower oil spill covering an area of more than 3,500 square meters.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Pace of energy sector recovery is too slow
items.teaser: After reviewing strike damage in Sumy and Kyiv oblasts, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged faster energy sector recovery alongside updated mobile fire group operations to protect agricultural facilities.

items.title: Operation Carthage suspect General Duka released from pre-trial detention
items.teaser: The SSU major general denies wrongdoing and calls the case revenge from NABU. His lawyer says an appeal against the court's preventive measure is due on 26 November.

items.teaser: An additional electric motor rumored in Ukrainian military Signal chats doesn’t exist, Zelenskyy’s defense tech adviser says.

items.title: Born to Be Independent: Kyiv Independent launches a new collection for its fifth anniversary

items.title: Xi-Putin-Trump-Gipfel in China?
items.teaser: Peking agiert vorsichtig angesichts der Spekulationen über ein mögliches Gipfeltreffen zwischen Xi, Putin und Trump. China möchte den Eindruck vermeiden, sich zu stark in den Ukraine-Krieg einzumischen.

items.title: Ukrainische „Neptun“- Raketen treffen Produktionsstätte, Lager und Servicezentrum für Drohnen in Russland

items.title: Ukrainian oil company Korolivskyi Smak halts production amid Russian attacks and power cuts
items.teaser: Kirovohrad-based food producer Korolivskyi Smak has completed final shipments and ceased oilseed purchasing as severe power supply issues and air strike threats prevent stable factory operations.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff confirms strike on Lukoil refinery in Volgograd, oil processing units hit
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka oil refinery in Russia overnight on November 13.

items.title: Car belonging to former Azarov spokesperson explodes in Moscow – media
items.teaser: A car belonging to Sergei Zavorotny, former press secretary to former Ukrainian Prime Minister Mykola Azarov, exploded in Moscow early on Friday, November 13.

items.title: Ukrainian-founded drone maker UForce raises $700 million at $6 billion valuation

items.title: 13 Verletzte bei russischem Angriff auf Wohnhaus in Saporischschja, darunter fünf Kinder

items.title: Ukraine seeks explanation on Starshield speed restrictions from US
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 13 that the restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line, making it "impossible" to use interceptors against Shahed-type drones.

items.title: Merz: Germany will be a guaranteed participant in peace talks on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says the first peace talks involving European representatives are expected in the coming weeks, with countries represented in Abu Dhabi likely to take part.

items.title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia: Injury toll rises to 25, rescue operations completed
items.teaser: The number of people injured after Russian forces struck residential apartment buildings in Zaporizhzhia has risen to 25, including six children.

items.title: Russian attack on Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics in Kyiv injures three patients – photos
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack on the Ukrainian capital has damaged the National Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics, resulting in a fire and injuries among patients.

items.title: Ukraine has lost 400 locomotives since start of year
items.teaser: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives since Russia's full-scale invasion began. Nearly 15 attacks on railway rolling stock have been recorded since the start of November.

items.title: Russian strike on Kyiv damages National Academy of Arts building
items.teaser: A Russian aerial attack on the Ukrainian capital has caused damage to a historic 19th-century building, blowing out its windows.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports strike on key fuel supplier of Russian forces – video
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says drones hit primary processing units and storage tanks at the Volgograd refinery, which handles about 15 million tonnes of oil a year, sparking a fire.

items.title: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit Russian drone production facility, warehouse, service center in Rostov-on-Don
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Navy used its Neptune coastal missile system to strike a Russian drone production facility, warehouse and service center in Rostov-on-Don overnight on November 13.

items.title: Russia's advance in Ukraine has slowed significantly, Air Assault Forces commander says
items.teaser: Heavy casualties are limiting Moscow's ability to sustain its offensive despite its manpower advantage, Maj. Gen. Oleh Apostol, commander of Ukraine's Air Assault Forces, said during a meeting with journalists.

items.title: Top security official released on $1.4 million bail in major corruption case
items.teaser: Duka is a suspect in a sweeping investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) into scam call centers. The probe led to the ouster of Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko, who fled Ukraine in September, and implicated senior officials in his office.

items.title: Government to submit updated anti-corruption strategy to parliament soon – PM Koretskyi
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers is working on a new anti-corruption strategy that will include reforms of law enforcement agencies, in particular the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) and the State Bureau of Investigation (SBI).

items.title: Russen töten in Region Donezk vier Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer wurden vier Menschen am 12. November in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Poland charges a Ukrainian helper in Russia’s plot to blow up a freight train on Ukraine’s supply line
items.teaser: The indictment says the attackers aimed to frighten many people and sway public opinion, not just damage a railway

items.title: Ukraine’s grid operator kept all-day blackouts in parts of the country after Russia’s latest strikes on the grid
items.teaser: Russian strikes on 13 November killed four Ukrainian civilians and injured more than 40.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on apartment building in Zaporizhzhia rises to 13, including five children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian strike on a five-story apartment building in Zaporizhzhia has risen to 13, including five children.

items.title: Zelenskyy urges closer contact with US amid Starshield restrictions at the front
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president has instructed his officials to intensify contacts with the Pentagon and SpaceX as the speed limit on Starshield systems hinders the interception of Russian drones.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights commissioner: Kostiantynivka was not discussed during talks on humanitarian missions
items.teaser: Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions, though Kyiv has a priority list of occupied settlements.

items.title: Geheimdienste erhalten mehr Befugnisse im Inland und Ausland
items.teaser: Die deutschen Nachrichtendienste bekommen mehr Befugnisse für die Abwehr von Spionage, Terrorismus und Sabotage.

items.title: Russia strikes Zaporizhzhia, injures 50, including 8 children
items.teaser: Rescuers freed 14 people who had been trapped in their apartments following the strike, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said.

items.title: Kallas: Kushner finally admits Europe must help shape outcome of Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: Europe must not only be present at negotiations to end Russia’s war against Ukraine, but also have a say in their outcome.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian UAV production and service facilities
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Navy has successfully targeted a UAV production plant, a storage site, and a service centre supplying the Russian forces.

items.title: Germany to provide Ukraine with another €200m in winter aid
items.teaser: Germany's Bundestag Budget Committee approved an extra €200 million for Ukraine's electricity, heating and water supplies as Russian attacks on infrastructure continue.

items.title: European Political Community: Ukraine must set its own terms for peace and receive credible security guarantees
items.teaser: Participants at the European Political Community summit in Dublin adopted a declaration on key principles of European security, reaffirming that Ukraine itself must be involved in determining the path to peace and that European countries must have a say in decisions concerning Europe’s security.

items.title: Russian records list 11,335 foreign war dead. Ukrainian intelligence says one brigade uses Africans as human shields
items.teaser: Deaths in the leaked files suggest Russia recruited in waves: Nepal, then Sri Lanka and China, then Colombia, Kenya, and Nigeria.

items.title: Russia again targets high-voltage substations overnight – PM Koretskyi
items.teaser: Overnight on November 13, Russian forces struck high-voltage substations. Medical facilities, logistics infrastructure and residential buildings also came under attack.

items.title: Ukrainian soldiers evacuate last resident of Mala Tokmachka after five-month rescue operation
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops have rescued the last resident of the village of Mala Tokmachka in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Svitlana Podolska, 64, spent five months with the soldiers before finally reaching safer territory.

items.title: Forty European states sign joint declaration on continent's security principles
items.teaser: Released by the Élysée Palace, a new joint declaration backed by 40 European states stresses that peace terms must involve Ukraine and rejects security talks with Moscow while aggression continues.

items.title: Russia asks for a pause in the Donbas city of Kostiantynivka after more than a year of assaults failed to take it—ISW sees a bid to mass troops for nearby Druzhkivka
items.teaser: The city still stands as a Ukrainian-held ruin, and a truce there would be close to impossible to police, with Russian and Ukrainian troops fighting in the same streets.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 175 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon in Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 12. November kam es zu 175 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: UK fund puts £113 million into Ukrainian-founded Magura maker as it plans to spread production beyond Ukraine
items.teaser: Britain's wealth fund co-led UFORCE's $700 million round; UK-built Magura boats are to use over 70% British content.

items.title: Ukraine continues fortifying border with Belarus amid persistent threat – SBGS spox
items.teaser: The level of engineering and fortification work along Ukraine’s border with Belarus is high, and efforts to strengthen it are ongoing.

items.title: Russian forces strike apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, four injured, including children
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a five-story residential building in the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia, injuring at least four people, including two children.

items.title: EU foreign ministers to discuss strengthening air defence and winter aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: EU ministers prepare for a high-level Foreign Affairs Council session featuring Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, tackling winter energy grid stabilisation alongside upcoming sanctions on Russian banks and shadow fleets.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 61 across Ukraine over past day, spark fire at Kyiv hospital
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 117 long-range attack drones, Gerbera and simulator drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 13, including 63 jet-powered drones, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Ukrainian battlefield successes shape allies’ stance and influence negotiations – Air Assault Forces Commander
items.teaser: Successful Ukrainian Defense Forces offensive operations have significance not only on the battlefield but also internationally, demonstrating to partners Ukraine's ability to withstand the Russian military and regain control of its territory.

items.title: Quantum Systems: Cyberangriff auf deutschen Drohnenhersteller
items.teaser: Quantum Systems beliefert auch die Ukraine mit Drohnen. Das Start-up aus Bayern hat nach eigenen Angaben nun einen Cyberangriff feindlicher Akteure eingedämmt.

items.title: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia industrial facility kills man
items.teaser: A man has been killed as a result of a Russian strike that targeted a facility in the city and caused a fire.

items.title: Staatsschutz ermittelt: Auto von Julian Reichelt abgebrannt
items.teaser: In der Nacht zu Freitag brennt das Auto von "Nius"-Chefredakteur Julian Reichelt in Berlin. Er selbst spricht von einem gezielten Anschlag. Die Ermittlungen übernimmt der Staatsschutz.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Wolgograd: Einer der größten Raffinerien Russlands brennt
items.teaser: In russischem Wolgograd brach infolge eines Drohnenangriffs in der Nacht zum 13. November Feuer in der „Lukoil“-Raffinerie Wolgograd aus.

items.title: Prosecutor's office receives order to probe top Zelensky ally but no investigation opened so far
items.teaser: The Anti-Corruption Action Center, an independent watchdog, has lambasted acting Prosecutor General Anton Kovalskyi for refusing to open the investigation so far.

items.title: Vandalismus - Brandanschlag auf Auto von "Nius"-Chefredakteur Reichelt
items.teaser: Auf das Auto des Chefredakteurs des rechtspopulistischen Portal "Nius", Julian Reichelt, hat es in der Nacht in Berlin einen Brandanschlag gegeben.

items.title: Russian attack on Odesa kills two, injures seven
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian attack on Odesa has reached two, while the number of injured has risen to seven.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Second car bomb to hit Russia in two days
items.teaser: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has more.

items.title: Kernel suspends operations at all its oilseed processing plant following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Ukrainian agricultural holding company Kernel has suspended operations at all its oilseed processing plant and halted sunflower seed purchases following a series of large-scale Russian attacks on food industry facilities.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russia hit with second car bomb attack in two days
items.teaser: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has more.

items.title: Car explosion in Moscow reportedly injures ex-Azarov press secretary
items.teaser: Zavorotny served as press secretary during the presidency of Viktor Yanukovych in Ukraine and fled to Russia in 2014 after Yanukovych's ouster following the Euromaidan Revolution.

items.title: Cats, dogs, parrots and a dog named Raccoon: 105 animals evacuated from Oleshky during humanitarian mission
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has shared updates on 105 animals evacuated from occupied Oleshky, including a pregnant dog who gave birth to four puppies after reaching safety

items.title: Ukraine secures seizure of Paris mansion belonging to sanctioned businessman Zhevago
items.teaser: A Paris mansion worth $40 million and owned by sanctioned Ukrainian businessman Kostiantyn Zhevago has been seized at the request of the Office of the Prosecutor General of Ukraine.

items.title: Nach Putin-Treffen: US-Vermittler wollen Europa in Ukraine-Verhandlungen einbeziehen
items.teaser: Nach Putin-Treffen: US-Vermittler wollen Europa in Ukraine-Verhandlungen einbeziehen

items.title: Vascular surgeon explains how wounded people should use tourniquets to avoid losing limb
items.teaser: To preserve a limb, a tourniquet should not remain in place for more than two hours. If conditions allow, it should be loosened every two hours and then reapplied.

items.title: Informelles Treffen in Dublin: Wie einig ist sich die EU in puncto Ukraine?
items.teaser: Beim Treffen der Staat- und Regierungschefs in Dublin steht die Ukraine weiter im Fokus. Vor allem über weitere Finanzhilfen wird diskutiert. Kanzler Merz hat dabei klare Vorstellungen. Von Kathrin Schmid.

items.title: Another Ukrainian agribusiness suspends oil plant operations following Kernel
items.teaser: The Potoky oil extraction plant in Dnipro has temporarily stopped processing sunflower seeds due to power outages and security threats.

items.title: Feindlicher Angriff auf Odessa: Zwei Tote, fünf Verletzte
items.teaser: Die russischen Truppen haben am 13. November die Hafenstadt Odessa angegriffen.

items.title: Czechia could deliver first four L-39 Skyfox jets to Ukraine in 2027, foreign minister says
items.teaser: The L-39 Skyfox, manufactured by Czech company Aero Vodochody, is a subsonic jet primarily designed for military pilot training. It can also carry out light attack, reconnaissance, and aerial patrol missions.

items.title: Russia’s Volgograd refinery burns as a Ukrainian monitor says Ukraine now appears to hit whole plants, not single units
items.teaser: Ukraine has been striking Russian fuel production for two weeks straight, and this time it hit one of Lukoil’s biggest plants.

items.title: Russian offensive loses momentum as advance on frontline slows significantly – Ukraine’s Air Assault Commander
items.teaser: The pace of Russian forces' advance along the frontline has slowed significantly compared with earlier periods of the war.

items.title: Woman dies in hospital after Russian strike on bus in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: A female passenger who sustained severe injuries during a Russian attack on a public bus in Zaporizhzhia Oblast has passed away despite doctors' efforts.

items.title: Nach Affären-Beben - Elon Musk will Ex-Nvidia-Boss einstellen
items.teaser: Jensen Huang tritt nach Affären und Spionagevorwürfen als Konzernchef zurück.

items.title: The war’s largest POW exchange is coming, Zelenskyy says after meeting Witkoff and Kushner. Russia won’t discuss sparing the grid
items.teaser: Ukraine’s negotiators pushed for calm at sea and a pause in strikes on power plants, and Moscow’s team answered that it had no permission to discuss either.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 80 von 117 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 80 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 12. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: 2026 Australian Arbitration Week Recap: Australian Arbitration Survey (2nd edition) - First Look
items.teaser: Higher user satisfaction does not remove the challenge of making arbitration more efficient. The Australian Arbitration Survey 2026 (“Survey”) offers an opportunity to examine that tension. In February 2026, the Australian Centre for International Commercial Arbitration (“ACICA”) – with the support of HKA and FTI Consu

items.title: European Alliance of News Agencies expels TASS
items.teaser: Russia's state news agency TASS has been expelled from the European Alliance of News Agencies (EANA).

items.title: Bail posted for Carthage suspect General Duka
items.teaser: Following reports of internal fundraising among Security Service of Ukraine staff, contributions exceeded the court-ordered US$1.4m bail for Carthage case suspect Serhii Duka.

items.title: Car of former aide to fugitive ex-PM Azarov explodes in Moscow – video
items.teaser: A Toyota SUV has blown up in the Russian capital, severely injuring Sergei Zavorotny, a Russian propagandist and alleged intelligence officer.

items.title: Russian attack on Vinnytsia: three injured, over 20 homes damaged
items.teaser: Three people have been injured in a Russian attack on Vinnytsia, with 16 private houses and five apartment buildings damaged.

items.title: Hungarian PM eyes Zakarpattia for next talks with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Following brief summit sidelines talks in Dublin, Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has said diplomats are working to arrange a meeting with Zelenskyy in Zakarpattia before the end of November

items.title: Putin will Europäer bei Ukraine-Gesprächen einbeziehen
items.teaser: Nach einem Treffen mit dem Kremlchef zeigt sich US-Unterhändler Kushner vorsichtig optimistisch. Zwar gibt es weiter große Differenzen zwischen Moskau und Kyjiw, doch auch ein großer Gefangenenaustausch zeichnet sich ab.

items.title: Signale für europäische Beteiligung an Ukraine-Gesprächen
items.teaser: Nach einem Treffen mit Kremlchef Putin zeigt sich US-Unterhändler Kushner vorsichtig optimistisch. Doch die Botschaften aus Moskau sind widersprüchlich. Kanzler Merz sieht auch Deutschland am Verhandlungstisch.

items.title: Russian overnight attack partially destroys second floor of Kyiv hospital, injures three patients
items.teaser: A medical facility operated by the National Academy of Medical Sciences was damaged in Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv, leaving three patients injured.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 2.590 weitere Soldaten an einem Tag
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 13. November 2026 auf rund 1.618.920 Soldaten, darunter 2.590 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Drone attack sparks fire at one of Russia's largest oil refineries in Volgograd – media
items.teaser: The Volgograd oil refinery, owned by Russian oil company Lukoil, caught fire following a drone attack overnight on November 13.

items.title: Splitting the ICC’s Afghanistan Investigation: Judicial Oversight or Overreach?
items.teaser: On 5 October 2026, Pre-Trial Chamber II of the International Criminal Court (ICC) unsealed four warrants of arrest against senior Taliban leaders in the Situation in Afghanistan. The warrants, which were initially issued under seal on 8 July 2025 and 9 September 2025, concern the charge of gender persecution as a crime

items.title: News kompakt: Microsoft-Störung trifft Nutzer weltweit
items.teaser: Nach weltweiten Ausfällen kämpft Microsoft weiter mit Problemen bei seinen Cloud-Diensten. Bei den Verhandlungen über ein Ende des Ukraine-Kriegs sollen auch die Europäer mit am Tisch sitzen. Der DW-Nachrichtenüberblick.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Odesa rises to two, five injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Odesa on the morning of November 13.

items.title: Russian strikes on Kharkiv Oblast injure 11 people, including minors
items.teaser: A Russian aerial assault on the towns of Malynivka and Zlatopil has caused casualties among residents following hits on residential buildings and a facility.

items.title: War update: 175 clashes on front lines over past day, most attacks recorded on Kostiantynivka axis
items.teaser: Russian occupation forces made 175 attempts to storm Ukrainian positions over the past day, with the highest number of attacks recorded in the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors.

items.title: Sechs Verletzte, darunter Kinder: Brand in Wohnhaus in Riwne nach russischem Angriff gelöscht
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Angriffs in der Nacht zum 13. November auf ein Hochhaus in Riwne wurden sechs Menschen verletzt, darunter zwei Kinder.

items.title: Der Fall Jensen Huang – wir sind alle Teil der Spionage-Welt
items.teaser: Einem der mächtigsten Manager des dritten Jahrtausends wurde die älteste Sünde der Welt zum Verhängnis. Die Affäre zeigt aber auch, wie omnipräsent und gefährlich Wirtschaftsspionage ist. Wir müssen handeln.

items.title: Ukrainerin bricht eigenen Rekord im Apnoetauchen
items.teaser: Die Ukrainerin Kateryna Sadurska hat ihren eigenen Rekord im Apnoetauchen gebrochen. Ohne Flossen, Gewichte und Atemgerät ist sie bis auf 90 Meter Meerestiefe getaucht.
